objective: Find side-specific exact-time relationships that remain directionally useful across four chronological quarters of the Jul-Aug retrospective sample.
caveat: This uses the pre-dynamic-L50 artifact. A new rebuild is running with explicit replenishment/removal/churn/absorption and causal M1/M3/M5/H1 state; this file is the stability baseline to beat.

LOW.interpretation: The LOW relation is unusually stable across every chronological quarter: seller share falls on 15s and 180s windows, buyer counter-share rises on 30s, 60m downside penetration is deeper, activity is higher, and continuation price-impact/efficiency shows a short-vs-long divergence.

HIGH.interpretation: The HIGH relation is weaker in the old static-book artifact: near-touch/25-level depth is heavier, the 6h upside extension is more extreme, and short-vs-long buy price-impact decays. Dynamic ask replenishment/removal/absorption is the key missing measurement now being rebuilt.

conclusion: LOW already shows a stable multi-dimensional terminal-exhaustion signature across all four quarters. HIGH shows the same family but weaker because the old artifact only had static L50 depth. The new dynamic-L50 rebuild is explicitly designed to measure the missing absorption/churn component.
